name: plasticity/analyze
description: Dry-run analysis of what compaction would do to a model. Reads gate_gradients.json from the adapter directory, computes per-head utilization scores, and returns a topology showing which heads would be pruned/compressed/kept. Does NOT modify any files.

params.name: adapterPath
params.description: Path to adapter directory containing gate_gradients.json (output from training with GateGradientCallback)

params.name: config
params.description: Compaction config overrides: { minHeadsPerLayer, minKvHeadsPerLayer, deadThreshold, lowThreshold, highThreshold, saturatedThreshold, enableQuantization }

results.name: layerSummaries
results.description: Per-layer summary: head counts by precision tier, parameter reduction %

results.name: estimatedSavingsBytes
results.description: Estimated memory savings in bytes from compaction

results.name: saturatedHeads
results.description: Heads with utilization > saturatedThreshold that may benefit from higher rank LoRA

examples.description: Analyze a trained adapter's gate gradients
